resources.string: Edit build.prop properties with automatic backup. On read-only partitions, changes are saved as a systemless override and may require a reboot.
All system.prop overrides managed by AetherX will be restored to the state when the backup was made, not just the selected partition. A reboot is required to fully restore the runtime effects.
%1$s saved as a systemless override and applied to the active session.
%1$s saved as a systemless override. Reboot to load it at startup.
Backup %1$s restored. Reboot to remove the override\'s effect from the active session.
build.prop file can\'t be read. Make sure Root access is active and try reloading.
